ORDER This is the first bail application filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C., new Section 482 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 on behalf of applicant for grant of anticipatory bail relating to Crime No/FIR No. 175/2024, registered at Police Station Khajuri Sadak, District Bhopal (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Section 354(C), 376(2)(n), 386, 506 of Indian Penal Code.
2. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that the prosecutrix is major and both of them were in love relationship for long time.
Number of photographs and whatapp chat is place on record.
The said photographs and whatapp chat points towards the intimate love relation between the applicant and prosecutrix.
Later on allegation in respect of offence of rape is made against the applicant.
It is submitted that the applicant is a student, aged about 23 years and pursuing his study.
The applicant has no criminal antecedent.
The applicant will cooperate in the trial and will surrender his mobile phones and hard drive, if any to the Investigating Officer for carrying out investigation in the case.
The applicant will join the investigation within 2 MCRC-26902-2024 seven days after being released on anticipatory bail.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondent/State opposed the application for grant of anticipatory bail.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
5.

sentences.text:
Considering aforesaid circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed on the following conditions :
(i) Applicant will immediately join the investigation after being released on bail within a period of seven days to co-operate with the investigating agency.
(ii) If the applicant does not appear and co-operates in investigation, then prosecution is at liberty to file application for cancellation of anticipatory bail.

7. It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer for his regular appearance before Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard.
9. C.C. as per rules.
